bottleneckIsolated.contractMechanism: verbatimText is bound as an exact substring of the alias text, so a heading occupying part of a source occurrence is expressible and bindable today.
bottleneckIsolated.conclusion: The prompt never states that a heading may be a prefix of a longer source occurrence, and never mentions selectionMode. It reads as name the alias and echo its text. The capability exists; the instruction does not ask for it.
bottleneckIsolated.alsoNoted: The evidence entries for these three carry no marker and Bold=false, so there is no formatting signal separating heading from prose. The separation is semantic only, which makes the unstated instruction the load-bearing gap.
